script:
RP=$(control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/session --header 'Origin: http://localhost:3000' --expect 200 --print-header set-cookie | sed -n 's/^oh_app_backend_session=\([^;]*\);.*/\1/p')
test -n "$RP"
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie> --query view=main --auth none \
  --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$RP" --expect 200 --check path eq / --check query.view eq main
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/ --query path=echo --auth none \
  --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$RP" --expect 200 --check path eq / --check query.path eq echo
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie> --query path=echo --auth none \
  --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$RP" --expect 200 --check path eq / --check query.path eq echo \
  --save F29.proxy-root-path-query/get  # bug
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie> --query 'path=..' --auth none \
  --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$RP" --expect 200 --check path eq / --check query.path eq ..  # bug
control-agent-server ws listen <redacted:session-cookie> --query path=ws --auth none --header "Origin: $S" \
  --header "Cookie: oh_app_backend_session=$RP" --send qa-f29-root --duration 5 --expect-close 1011 --expect-frames 0  # bug
failed_command: control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie> --query path=echo --auth none --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$RP" --expect 200 --check path eq / --check query.path eq echo --save F29.proxy-root-path-query/get
